verdict.rationale: Apify documents headless, scriptable operation. Its official CLI controls the platform from the terminal or shell scripts, and its JS/Python API clients start Actors, wait for them to finish, and retrieve results with no UI. That covers the core of headless automation. However, no evidence shows CI-specific use (CI pipeline integration, non-interactive token auth in CI, exit-code behavior), so the CI part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented CI pipeline integration (e.g., GitHub Actions or other CI recipes), explicit non-interactive/CI authentication guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
